text:
leah: running into ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED for onboarding sample on Cloudflare Workers after latest sdk publish. minimal import shown below.

om: can you paste package.json?

leah: package snippet:
```json
{\"name\":\"redwood-inference\",\"version\":\"3.1.1\",\"main\":\"dist/index.cjs\",\"exports\":{\"./dist/index.js\":\"./dist/index.cjs\"},\"types\":\"dist/index.d.ts\"}
```

kai: exports map only exposing CJS. Edge expects an ESM import condition or direct ESM file. Bundlers sometimes resolve imports to ./dist/index.js and get blocked by the exports map.

nat: TS/IDE issue too: when an exports map exists, Typescript's resolution can prefer the exports mapping for types. If the root or subpath doesn't expose typings, tssserver may not find declarations and intellisense breaks.

leah: proposed fix we tested locally: update exports to expose import/require/types and package.json so bundlers can read it. Example that worked in the local edge repro:
```json
{\"exports\":{\".\":{\"import\":\"./dist/index.mjs\",\"require\":\"./dist/index.cjs\",\"types\":\"./dist/index.d.ts\"},\"./package.json\":\"./package.json\"},\"types\":\"dist/index.d.ts\"}
```

om: +1. If building full ESM bundle is heavy, we can ship a tiny ESM entry file (dist/index.mjs) that re-exports the same public API from a small ESM wrapper. That avoids consumers having to import internal CJS files.

kai: note: re-exporting CJS from ESM can be messy. Best is to build a real ESM artifact or author a thin ESM module that imports the CJS using dynamic import and re-exports named exports. Simpler to produce a real ESM build for the package.

nat: also recommend adding an explicit types export so TS resolves properly. Some editors ignore top-level "types" when exports exists, so adding a types subpath in the export mapping is the reliable pattern.

leah: short-term workaround we can give to customers: either import the explicit ESM path (e.g., `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/dist/index.mjs'`) or pin to the previous patch release that didn't modify exports.

dev-bot: PR opened: revert-exportmap-change -> #3301. CI change: add Vercel Edge + Cloudflare Pages smoke matrix for packaging-related PRs.

leah: action items:
- alex: cut patch release to revert the export-only change and publish dual-export (P0)
- sam: add edge-emulator smoke job in CI and wire it to packaging PRs (P1)
- docs: short note in SDK packaging README about export maps, edge runtimes, and TS quirks (P2)

om: once patch is published, we'll advise support to route customers to the new patch and remove the temporary import-workaround from our KB.

dev-bot: deploy preview built and smoke queued on Vercel/Cloudflare.

leah: thanks everyone — attaching the customer repro to the issue and will follow up when the patch is live. :thumbsup:
